description: Generate a CHANGELOG.md file documenting changes between git tag v2.0.0 and HEAD. The repository is at /home/ga/workspace/sample-project. Create a file named CHANGELOG.md in the repository root with the following structure: (1) A header 'Changelog' or '# Changelog', (2) A version section for version 2.1.0 marked as '## [2.1.0]' or similar, (3) Subsections for 'Features', 'Bug Fixes', 'Breaking Changes', and 'Chores', (4) List commits from git history between v2.0.0 and HEAD under appropriate categories. Key commits to include: authentication/OAuth2 feature, file upload feature, WebSocket memory leak fix, timezone handling fix, API v2 schema breaking change, dependency updates, and API client refactoring. Filter out noise commits like 'wip', 'merge branch', and 'typo'. Use VSCode's Source Control view, GitLens extension, or integrated terminal to view git log. Format the file in Markdown and save it.
